simple: Zero trust access to internal applications (ZTNA) instead of VPN: an employee sees only the permitted applications, not the whole network, with identity and device posture checks. Part of TrendAI Vision One Zero Trust Secure Access (ZTSA): with or without an agent, for corporate and personal devices; access is revoked dynamically when the user or device risk score rises. Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
